name: audioslice
description: Set up and diagnose AudioSlice, an advanced realtime audio analyzer for realtime visuals and VJing
long_description: Connects Claude to a running AudioSlice so you can ask what a track can drive, build OSC modulators for it, and fix OSC networking issues.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Is AudioSlice running, hearing audio, and sending OSC?

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: What is in the audio right now, per stem.

tools.name: list_outputs
tools.description: List OSC destinations and their modulators.

tools.name: describe_modulator
tools.description: Check whether one modulator is actually firing.

tools.name: create_modulator
tools.description: Add a modulator to an output.

tools.name: delete_output
tools.description: Remove an output and all its modulators.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.description: Change the tempo source or metronome BPM.

tools.name: set_audioslice_token
tools.description: Store the API token, if one is set.

tools.name: list_audio_devices
tools.description: List audio inputs and which is open.

tools.name: tap_tempo
tools.description: Restart the beat grid, like 'Tap for 1'.

tools.name: save_patch
tools.description: Save the current configuration by name.

tools.name: load_patch
tools.description: Replace the configuration with a saved patch.

prompts.name: what_can_i_do
prompts.description: Analyse the track and suggest what to drive.
prompts.text: What can I do with this track?

port.title: AudioSlice port
port.description: Only needed if you changed the HTTP API port in AudioSlice's Advanced settings. Normally leave this alone - the port is detected automatically.

token.title: API token
token.description: Only needed if you set a token in AudioSlice's Advanced settings. Leave empty otherwise - AudioSlice ships without one.
